title: Current News and Portfolio Changes
summary: A fiscal pause prompts selective portfolio changes.
coverage_note: All numbered text blocks and image labels read. Material theses, forecasts and explanations are included; routine holdings lists, incidental statistics, company descriptions and boilerplate are excluded. Chart pixels were not inspected.

claims.reason: Transfers supported income, but declaring stimulus inactive omits ongoing programs, delayed payments and accumulated savings. A flow slowdown is not the elimination of all fiscal support.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: May 2020 personal income and outlays
evidence.finding: Personal income fell 4.2% in May after revised 10.8% growth in April. Declining recovery payments explained much of the decrease, partly offset by unemployment benefits. Spending rose 8.2%.

evidence.title: CARES and Consolidated Appropriations Acts
evidence.finding: The subsequent broad relief act passed Congress December 21 and was signed December 27, 2020, after the election rather than during summer.

claims.reason: A stock correction occurred, but quarterly real GDP continued growing in Q3 and Q4. A partially W-shaped economy is not a specified index and therefore receives no blanket success from a weak small-business series.
claims.timing_assessment: Original horizon retained: until next fiscal package
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: 2020 Q4 GDP second estimate
evidence.finding: Contemporary estimate: Q3 2020 real GDP +33.4% annualized, Q4 +4.1%. There was no renewed quarterly contraction in the second half of 2020.

evidence.title: Autumn 2020 correction
evidence.publisher: S&P Dow Jones Indices via FRED
evidence.finding: S&P 500 closes August 24 3431.28, September 2 3580.84, September 23 3236.92, December 24 3703.06. September peak-to-trough close decline approximately 9.60%, followed by new highs. Excludes dividends.

claims.reason: The later inflation rise was substantial. The short disinflation phase needs a defined monthly measure and window, and fiscal timing does not independently identify the cause of the later price surge.
claims.timing_assessment: Original horizon retained: near term versus longer term
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: June 2022 Consumer Price Index
evidence.finding: June 2022 headline CPI rose 9.1% over twelve months.

claims.reason: The broad dollar rose about 0.82% over the following month. This verifies a modest bounce, not a new sustained bull market or precise DXY level. A low-conviction possibility should receive little calibration weight.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: Broad dollar autumn bounce
evidence.finding: Nominal broad trade-weighted dollar August 24, 2020 116.9120; September 25 117.8679, +0.82%. This broad measure is not DXY.

claims.reason: No endpoint or invalidation threshold is given. Separate this long-run view from the successful short bounce instead of allowing opposite directions to cover every possible path.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

claims.reason: The September drawdown matched the risk warning, but the market first rose and subsequently reached new highs before the December package. The Citigroup model was not independently backtested, and the author expressly avoids a specific short-term call.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

claims.reason: The issuer confirms a material treasury Bitcoin purchase, establishing direct corporate exposure. Equity holders also bear software, management, leverage and premium/discount risk; it is not identical to owning spot Bitcoin.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Business performance and shareholder return are distinct.

evidence.title: Bitcoin treasury allocation
evidence.finding: The company acquired 21,454 bitcoins for $250 m including fees and adopted Bitcoin as principal treasury reserve asset.

claims.reason: Both the disclosed purchase-date and next-publication-close sensitivities gained roughly 300% through sixteen months, far above SPY. This verifies the investment direction within the stated horizon, not the private portfolio's actual fill, exit or risk-adjusted return.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Business performance and shareholder return are distinct.

evidence.title: MSTR sixteen-month checks
evidence.finding: Using disclosed August 18, 2020 purchase date close through December 17, 2021: adjusted-close +299.32% versus SPY +38.75%. Using next close after public article, August 24, 2020-December 23, 2021: +301.95% versus SPY +40.21%. No actual subscriber fill or sale verified; vendor split-adjusted USD proxies.

claims.reason: The author reports closing the short at a loss. Without order records the actual loss cannot be reconstructed; bubble lacks an endpoint or valuation threshold, and revenue stagnation does not prove future growth cannot accelerate.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Business performance and shareholder return are distinct.

claims.reason: The disclosed five-year sensitivity strongly favors Apple, challenging the preference. The author gave no exact long-term endpoint, and Tencent's distributions in kind need reconciliation, so this is adverse comparative evidence rather than an arbitrary binary final score.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Business performance and shareholder return are distinct.

evidence.title: Tencent/Apple five-year sensitivity
evidence.finding: August 24, 2020-August 22, 2025 adjusted-close proxies: TCEHY +23.91%, AAPL +86.04%. Evaluator-selected five-year endpoint, USD listings, no fees/taxes; distributions in kind require separate reconciliation.

claims.reason: Population and adoption support a market opportunity but do not determine per-share returns. Regulatory intervention, capital allocation, currency and initial price can dominate the adoption thesis.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Business performance and shareholder return are distinct.

claims.reason: Revenue remained below its 2019 level in 2021 but reached a record in 2022. The warning was more accurate for the first year than the second; percentage growth off a depressed 2020 base is distinct from recovery to the old level.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: 2022 annual results
evidence.finding: 2022 revenues $17.1 bn, 56% above 2021 and 13% above 2019; annual GAAP EPS $76.35. The prior-year revenue base was approximately $11 bn, below 2019.

claims.reason: Tencent returned -36.04% and +23.91% at three and five years; Booking returned +68.91% and +215.81%. The Booking replacement materially underperformed in both sensitivities. The BBL leg requires dual-listing unification and demerger accounting, so a BHP ticker history is not silently substituted for the actual sold security.
claims.direction_assessment: See independently checked outcomes and qualifications in reason.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Business performance and shareholder return are distinct.

evidence.title: TCEHY historical price sensitivity
evidence.finding: 3-year comparison 2020-08-24 to 2023-08-23: TCEHY -36.04% cumulative, -13.86% annualized; SPY +35.15% cumulative. 5-year comparison 2020-08-24 to 2025-08-22: TCEHY +23.91% cumulative, 4.39% annualized; SPY +102.10% cumulative. First common close strictly after publication, last common close on/before anniversary. USD vendor-adjusted-close proxies include vendor dividend/split adjustments; no fees, taxes or actual subscriber trades. These are evaluator-defined sensitivities unless the claim explicitly names the horizon.

First common close strictly after publication, last common close on/before anniversary. framework_lessons: A precise holding window improves auditability.
assessment: The MSTR allocation is a strong dated investment success. The near-term correction and modest dollar bounce occurred, while the economy did not return to quarterly contraction. The Tencent preference faces adverse comparative evidence, and its detailed operating thesis is evaluated separately in the next article.
verification_limitations: Retrieved 2026-11-07; publication-date wording is not authenticated.

Public market series are available, but not every investment claim has a defined horizon or reconciled corporate-action-adjusted return. Unverified outcomes remain unscored; macro data use latest available vintages.
